title: Founders Associate (w/m/d)
description:
Über uns
Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser .
In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (
 42b EnWG).
 Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:
 Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,
 ~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und
 digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.
 Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.
Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.
Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.
Dein Profil
 Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen im Consulting (Tier 1/Tier 2), High-Growth Start-ups, oder im VC/PE gesammelt
 Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation in einem relevanten Bereich wie z.B. Wirtschaftsingenieurswesen, Energiewirtschaft oder Betriebswirtschaft
 Du hast bereits Erfahrung in der Energie- oder Immobilienbranche, oder bringst ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Start-ups, Energie oder Immobilien mit
 Du denkst unternehmerisch, triffst eigenständig fundierte Entscheidungen und setzt klare Prioritäten mit Blick auf Impact, Skalierbarkeit und langfristigen Unternehmenserfolg
 Du suchst bewusst keinen 9-to-5-Job, sondern willst in einem schnelllebigen, gründer-nahen Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen, Strukturen aufbauen und das Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten
 Du strebst danach, die beste Version deiner selbst zu werden und suchst Umgebungen, in denen du dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst
 Du bist in Berlin (oder bereit umzuziehen) - unser Büro ist unser Homebase
 Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch fließend
 Deine Aufgaben
 Mission der Rolle
 Du arbeitest als verlängerter Arm und Stabstelle der beiden Gründer. Du stellst sicher, dass strategische Prioritäten klar definiert und operativ sauber umgesetzt werden.
Dein Ziel: Strategische Projekte mit Fokus, Geschwindigkeit und Struktur in enger Abstimmung mit den Gründern in ein schnell wachsendes Unternehmen zu tragen und operativ zu ownen.
 Sparringspartner der Gründer
 Du strukturierst komplexe Fragestellungen (z.B. Performance Reviews und Talent Acquisition) und bereitest fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen vor
 Du übersetzt Vision und Strategie in konkrete Roadmaps und operative Ziele
 Du challengst Annahmen, identifizierst Risiken und sorgst für klare Priorisierung
 Steuerung unternehmenskritischer Initiativen
 Du übernimmst Ownership für bereichsübergreifende Schlüsselprojekte (z. B. Finance-Themen, neue Geschäftsmodelle, Organisationsdesign, Fundraising-Vorbereitung)
 Du stellst die strukturierte und fristgerechte Umsetzung strategischer Initiativen sicher
 Du identifizierst Engpässe frühzeitig und löst kritische Themen mit hoher Eigenverantwortung
 Organisationsentwicklung & Performance-Management
 Du hilfst beim Aufbau skalierbarer Strukturen, Entscheidungsprozesse und Reporting-Systeme
 Du etablierst klare Zielsysteme (z. B. OKRs) und Performance-Transparenz
 Du unterstützt bei Recruiting, Teamentwicklung und Führungsthemen
 Benefits
 Verantwortung: zentral Rolle in unserem Kernteam
 Vergütung: Kompetitives Gehalt und Anteile am Unternehmen
 Startdatum: so bald wie möglich, unbefristet
 Team & Benefits: Lustiges Team, Tech Budget von 2 Tsd.€, regelmäßige Team Events und Learning Lunches, Gratis Getränke, Deutschlandticket
 Weitere Vorteile: Tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern, Getränke & Snacks, Personalverantwortung und die Möglichkeit, das Unternehmen von Grund auf mitzugestalten
 Das Wichtigste: Du brennst für Unternehmertum und Start-ups. Bei uns entstehen keine endlosen Slide-Decks oder rein theoretische Modelle – wir bauen ein Unternehmen und machen tagtäglich einen großen Schritt nach vorne. Wenn du von Tag 1 an etwas Großem mitgestalten möchtest, bist du bei uns genau richtig.
 Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss
 Bei VREY sind wir davon überzeugt, dass Vielfalt uns als Unternehmen und Gesellschaft stärkt . Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen.
Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, zögere nicht, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. Wenn du von unserer Mission begeistert bist und glaubst, einen Beitrag leisten zu können, möchten wir von dir hören!
Der beste Weg ist eine warme Intro: Kennst du jemand, der auf diese Rolle passt? Empfiehl die Person und erhalte 3.000€ bei erfolgreicher Einstellung.
 Voraussetzung: Die Person ist uns noch nicht bei uns im Prozess und wird offiziell vorgeschlagen. Auszahlung nach bestandener Probezeit. Bei mehrfacher Nennung zählt die erste eingegangene Empfehlung.

title: Senior Project Manager (f/m/d) Strategic Manufacturing Projects
description:
Are you passionate about enabling the future of manufacturing? Join our team and play a key role in leading high-impact strategic projects across our network of 20+ factories.
The projects range from developing manufacturing footprint masterplans for entire factory networks and shaping strategic make-or-buy decisions, to launching new factories and contract manufacturing partnerships, as well as driving hands-on shopfloor improvements through lean, automation, digitalization, and AI.
 What We Offer You
 An attractive remuneration package
 Access to Siemens share plans
 Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests
 Barrier-free locations
 Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here.
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.
 How You’ll Make An Impact
 Partner with senior leaders to identify, shape, and execute the initiatives that matter most for the company's growth and transformation
 Lead strategic projects end-to-end until business impact
 Deliver measurable business impact by driving execution, managing risks proactively, and maintaining the highest standards of quality
 Align cross-functional, intercultural teams and external partners around a shared vision and turn strategy into results
 Accelerate performance on the shopfloor through lean, automation, digitalization, and AI-driven process improvements
 Build a unique understanding of our business and expand your global network
 Develop the experience and visibility needed for future leadership opportunities
 Your success is grounded in
 You have many years of experience leading complex projects in manufacturing environments, a proven track record of delivering measurable business impact, and a master's degree.
 You combine strong project management expertise with structured problem-solving methodologies (e.g., Six Sigma or comparable frameworks) to tackle complex challenges in a data-driven and results-oriented way.
 You thrive in ambiguity, take ownership, and proactively drive topics forward. You are a skilled facilitator, mediator, and communicator who can align diverse stakeholders and bridge the gap between executive leadership and shopfloor teams.
 You bring a hands-on manufacturing mindset combined with a passion for automation, digitalization, and AI, understanding how technology can improve productivity, quality, and operational performance.
 You feel at home on the shopfloor. Lean thinking, operational excellence, and continuous improvement are part of your DNA, and you can engage effectively with operators, engineers, factory leaders, and senior management alike.
 Experience in Electrical Distribution products (e.g., GIS, AIS, Vacuum Interrupters, or Circuit Breakers) and Engineering-to-Order (ETO) manufacturing is an advantage.
 You enjoy working across cultures and are excited to travel globally on a project basis to support our factories and drive sustainable business impact.
 You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.
As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities. In the case of equal qualifications, severely disabled applicants and applicants with equivalent status will be given preference.
 About Us
 At Smart Infrastructure Electrification & Automation our mission is to develop innovative and sustainable solutions that save energy and reduce the carbon footprint of buildings, infrastructure, and industries. We enable the transition to a sustainable energy system, while ensuring a reliable and affordable energy supply. That's why we are committed to creating a greener future and transforming the way we live and work.
www.siemens.de/careers – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.
FAQ – if you need further information on the application process.

title: Staff Product Manager, Marketing Automation - CANADA (Remote)
description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.
 Role Overview
 We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own a core part of how our clients market themselves: the websites, content, and campaigns that get them found, keep them top of mind, and turn attention into business. Our clients are real estate professionals, many of them top producers in luxury markets, and they count on us for the marketing they don't have time to do themselves.
Generating marketing content is easy now. Generating content a top agent is proud to put their name on is not. That bar, across every channel our clients use, is the game we're in. So is proving what works: showing clients how their channels feed each other and which ones are actually driving business.
This is a high-impact, high-visibility role with close collaboration across engineering, design, AI/ML, client success, and sales. You'll own a product area end to end, set its strategy, and grow its scope as we expand into new channels.
 What You'll Do
 Own the product strategy, roadmap, and results for a set of AI-powered marketing products, starting with how our clients get discovered and the content we create for them
 Make sure our clients get found, whether a prospective buyer or seller searches on Google or asks an AI assistant who to call
 Raise the quality bar on everything we create on our clients' behalf, so it sounds like them and reflects the brand they've built
 Design how channels work together, so a client's website, content, email, and social reinforce each other instead of running as separate tools
 Build the measurement and attribution that show clients, and us, how those channels drive each other and which ones are actually producing business
 Run structured betas with real clients, set clear hypotheses up front, and keep iterating until clients would be upset to lose what you've built
 Build the business case for your roadmap and tie it to adoption, retention, and revenue
 Ship with your own engineering and design partners, and work closely with client success and sales so launches land
 Who You Are
 7+ years of product management, including owning a product line end to end where you were accountable for adoption, outcomes, and revenue
 Marketing taste. You can tell great marketing from generic, and you know how a premium brand should and shouldn't show up. You'd catch the post that makes a client look bad before it ships
 Multichannel instincts. You understand how search, content, email, social, and paid work together as a system, and you want to see the numbers move across all of them, not just one
 Experience building marketing technology: products businesses use to grow their own customer base
 Solid SEO fundamentals, and a view of discovery that goes beyond the website to reviews, social, and what people say about a business across the web
 You run your area like a business. You build the case before you build the product, and you own the result
 Close to your customers. You talk to them often and can explain why something matters in their terms
 You create momentum in ambiguity. You narrow the problem, make a call, and move before every question is answered
 A communicator who can get a room excited, from engineers to executives to client success, and who earns trust across teams you don't manage
 You learn fast and use AI as a normal part of how you work: to research, to prototype, and to get to ground truth quickly
 Preferred Qualifications
 Product experience at a company serving small businesses or solo operators who judge you on results, such as Shopify, Squarespace, Mailchimp, HubSpot, Square, or Yelp
 You've built email, lifecycle, or campaign tools, or products that generate marketing content with AI
 Hands-on experience with marketing analytics or attribution products
 Familiarity with premium or luxury brands and how they market differently
 Experience at a platform where one change reaches many customers' sites or accounts at once
 A background in content, editorial, or brand work
 Join us in shaping the future of real estate
 The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.
We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.
Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.
More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.
Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform.
 Luxury Presence is an Equal Opport
